description: jQuery support module for CSS feature detection, including tests for pixel position, box sizing reliability, and margin right support.

methods.name: pixelPosition
methods.description: Returns whether the pixel position is reliable based on computed styles.

methods.name: boxSizingReliable
methods.description: Returns whether box sizing is reliable based on computed styles.

methods.name: reliableMarginRight
methods.description: Checks if the margin-right is computed correctly for a div with explicit width.
